rationale: Revised plan addresses self-review finding about data leakage from target-derived amount fields. Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from the feature set to ensure the early-warning model operates on claim-intake-available features only (clinical and administrative attributes: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, flags, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present). This ensures the model achieves its stated objective of flagging high-cost claims when they first arrive for nurse review, without relying on post-adjudication amounts that introduce leakage and prevent operational deployment.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate data leakage. The prior plan included these post-intake amount fields, which are not available at claim receipt and were driving unrealistic model performance (ROC-AUC 0.997). The revised plan uses only claim-intake-available features for a model that can operationally flag high-risk claims at review time.
